{{Quote|What demands would ''you'' make?''"<br />"''Pleasure yacht, a lifetime pass to the ''Errant Venture'' &hellip;''"<br />"''Stop kidding around.|Yakown Reth and Diss Ti'wyn|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand" />}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Diss Ti'wyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] pilot in [[Blackmoon Squadron]]. He flew in [[Yakown Reth]]'s squadron as Blackmoon Two. Ti'wyn had brown and gold fur and was known to be quite attractive, receiving a great deal of attention in social situations from both Bothans and Humans.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand" />

Ti'wyn listened calmly as Yakown Reth aired his grievances against General [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and the leadership of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in general. Ti'wyn urged his squad leader to keep calm and remain patient. Upon [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke's]] return from his expedition to Coruscant it was stated that, only that day, Blackmoon Squadron had lost three pilots, including its commander and second in command, with it later being revealed that Ti'wyn, while not [[Death/Legends|dead]], had battle stress that reduced him to a paranoid mess, and could no longer pilot even a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] took his place as Blackmoon Two, using his [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-Wing]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand" />
